§6Chlorine Gas§f

§aCorrosive and toxic - the gas that powers PVC, HPS, phosgene, and chemical weapons!§f

Chlorine Gas is a corrosive, toxic gas produced in the §bCombination Oven§f and §bElectrolysis Machine§f. It is critical for §bPVC§f, §bHPS§f, §bPhosgene§f, and various chemical weapons.

§6Production§f:
§b• Combination Oven§f: Chlorocalcite → §e250mB§f, Molysite → §e250mB§f, Sodalite → §e100mB§f, Glowstone Dust + Sulfur → §e100mB§f.
§b• Electrolysis Machine§f: Potassiumchloride or Calciumchloride Solution → §e125mB§f Chlorine Gas.

§6Uses§f:
§b•§f PVC Bar: §e250mB§f + §e250mB§f Unsaturated Hydrocarbons + Cadmium Powder → §e2×§f PVC.
§b•§f HPS: §e250mB§f + §e750mB§f Reformate Gas → §e1,000mB§f.
§b•§f Phosgene: §e500mB§f + §e500mB§f Unsaturated Hydrocarbons → §e1,000mB§f.
§b•§f Mustard Gas: §e250mB§f + §e750mB§f Reformate Gas + Sulfur.
§b•§f Chlorinated Petroleum Wax: §e100–250mB§f + Oil Tar or Paraffin Wax.
§b•§f 16" Chlorine Gas Artillery Shells: §e4,000mB§f per shell.

§ePS:§f The §bChlorocalcite§f route via the Combination Oven is most efficient at §e250mB§f per operation. Stockpile Chlorine Gas whenever you run your oven - it feeds into multiple mid-game chains!
